sentences.en: Fair competition is necessary for the healthy growth of industry.
sentences.zh: 公平竞争对于工业健康发展是必要的。

sentences.en: Effectively dealing with competition is an important part of life.
sentences.zh: 有效应对竞争是生活的重要组成部分。

sentences.en: Having fallen victim to increased competition, the company went bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 由于竞争加剧，该公司破产了。
